source.license: CC0 1.0 Universal, as stated in the repository README and Hugging Face dataset card accessed 2026-09-30
source.attribution: The source CSV identifies bykaranteli.com; the dataset card describes first-party quarterly futures basis snapshots.

nativeCalendar: 36 consecutive UTC daily snapshots from 2026-08-06 through 2026-09-10 for the source current_quarter BTC future expiring 2026-09-25. No dates or values were interpolated.

mapping.futures_basis_pct: Use the source annualized_pct field for symbol BTC and tenor current_quarter; retain the reported daily current-quarter contract yield without averaging or interpolation.

methodology: The source supplies spot_usd, future_usd, expiry and annualized_pct. The imported metric uses the supplied annualized_pct field directly for the BTC current-quarter tenor; next-quarter values and all non-BTC rows are excluded.
